gist: Trent Alexander-Arnold is currently third-choice right-back at Real Madrid under Jose Mourinho.

Jamie Carragher suggested Alexander-Arnold made a mistake joining Real Madrid.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Trent Alexander-Arnold has struggled for regular playing time at Real Madrid since joining in June 2025. Manager Jose Mourinho currently prefers Fede Valverde, a midfielder, at right-back, leaving Alexander-Arnold as third choice behind Valverde and Denzel Dumfries. He has featured in seven of Real's 13 matches this season, starting four times.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Alexander-Arnold's lack of regular minutes follows a difficult debut season impacted by hamstring, thigh, and muscle injuries, alongside frequent managerial changes. Former Liverpool defender Jamie Carragher stated that Alexander-Arnold made a mistake moving to Madrid, noting that being third choice suggests the club wants him to move on.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Alexander-Arnold hopes for more playing time during Real Madrid's three upcoming fixtures before the international break. Additionally, England manager Thomas Tuchel must decide whether to include him in the next England squad, announced on 6 November, for Nations League matches against Croatia and Spain.
